**Finding submitted: IP — missing (critical).**

The Agreement has no IP ownership provision anywhere. I checked every plausible location:

- **§1.1–1.3 / 1.4** — HDI designs, develops, hosts and bears the cost of the Site, but nothing says who owns the resulting Site, code or look and feel.
- **§5.2** — gives us only "exclusive artistic and editorial control", not ownership.
- **§5.3** — title language, but only to physical Deerskin Products before sale.
- **§6.1** — a trademark licence *from* us *to* HDI (beneficial/limited; not flagged here).
- **§8.1/8.3** — confidentiality only; no ownership of Content, user information or order data.
- **§10.2** — the "co-ownership" reference is about the parties' relationship (no joint venture), not IP joint ownership.

With HDI holding the Content, customer and order data and having built the Site, silence leaves our paid-for deliverables and data unallocated. I inserted a single new §5.5 Ownership clause at the preferred position, carrying only the eight checklist elements: our ownership plus HDI's assignment of the work product, HDI's retention of its pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence for embedded HDI IP, our retention of all rights in Content and site data, and no joint ownership. The redline validated with `ok:true` and no collateral edits to surrounding text.
